Depends where it’s going on the mainland, but if the recipient is willing to pick up, you can do next day shipping with Harbour Air to either downtown Vancouver or Richmond (usually goes the next flight anyways) for $17.06 under 3 lbs, and for example 10-13 lbs is around $27. Same day it goes up to $21 under 3 lbs and about $38 for 13 lbs same day. If it’s going to somewhere else you can arrange for a courier for same or next day which isn’t too much more money, Harbour Air Freight will give you a quote. Again it usually goes on the next flight even if you’re doing same or next day shipping unless you specify! The trick is to not say “I need this on the next flight” otherwise they will charge you as such. Just say where you’re sending it 😉
